subject: Re: Air freight quote request: Hamburg North to Toronto
body:
Hi Alex,

Thanks for the update. I’ll check on the Shipper’s Declaration and SDS and get back to you. Hope your week’s going well!

Klaus Weidner

classification.reasoning: The customer only acknowledges the update and says they will follow up with the requested documents; they are not providing missing shipment details yet.
